# CANDIDATE: DIX_VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Elevated dark‑pool short‑volume ratio (DIX) forecasts volatility expansion; when DIX is extreme (above its 20‑bar 80th percentile) and ATR compresses then expands (5‑bar ATR crossing above 0.6×20‑bar ATR) with a close beyond VWAP by ≥0.2×ATR(5), a breakout entry is signaled. This captures edge from dark‑pool flow anticipation of volatility regimes not yet reflected in price.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** When DIX > 20‑bar 80th percentile AND 5‑bar ATR crosses above 0.6×20‑bar ATR AND close beyond VWAP by ≥0.2×ATR(5), go long if close > VWAP, short if close < VWAP.  
**Exit:** Initial chart‑stop at most recent swing point opposite break direction, profit target at 2R, runner trailed using chandelier exit at 20% of highest‑since‑entry price.  
**Regime filters:** VIX between 15‑25 (moderate) and time after 10:30 ET to avoid opening‑gap distortions.
